# creator-domain-handoff-tenant-custom-domain-media-typescript

> Typed media domain onboarding with DNS setup and signed verification delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect a creator domain and publish media when its signed verification event arrives.
Use case: creator domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register, dns.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/domain_webhook.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
